$comment: High/critical npm audit advisories (npm audit --omit=dev) reviewed and accepted until reviewBy. Checked by scripts/check-audit.js (npm run audit:check). The entries come with the starter: its review of advisories in the starter's own dependency tree. Re-review them for your project and set owner to yourself; see docs/getting-started.md#dependency-advisories.

advisories.exposure: In the app bundles but not reached: query-string decodes only in parse(), which runs in React Navigation's default getStateFromPath; Expo Router replaces it with its own, which reads query strings with URL searchParams. Expo Router calls only query-string's stringify(), which encodes.
advisories.fix: None compatible: the fix is decode-uri-component 0.5.1, which is ESM-only and outside query-string 7's ^0.2.2 (query-string 7 loads it with require). Expo Router 58 no longer depends on query-string.

advisories.path: expo > @expo/cli > zod@3 (the app's own zod is 4.6.7 or later: package.json requires ^4.6.7)
advisories.exposure: Build tool only: the Expo CLI dev server validates dev-tools plugin and MCP extension schemas with zod 3 on the developer's machine. Not in the iOS, Android, or web bundles; the bundles use the direct zod dependency, which is patched.
advisories.fix: None released for zod 3, which @expo/cli requires (^3.25.76); patched only in zod 4.6.6.
